lessons: Reserve extra space inside the 40px text boundary for headings and caveats.
Connect to real mechanism ports; isolate parallel paths with separate gutters.
Use only allowlisted visible labels; omit mock writing, controls and decorative glyphs.

stories.layout: cross-section of a walled target and separate patch bench

draft_regions.label: Authorized scope
draft_regions.notes: A boundary surrounds test fixtures; one muted branch ends at the boundary. Keep unrelated services visibly outside it.

draft_regions.label: Reproduce finding
draft_regions.notes: At a separate test bench, abstract specimen, fixture and output coupon show that findings can be checked.

draft_regions.label: Review patch
draft_regions.notes: A detached bench layers report, candidate patch, retest fixture and maintainer handoff.

draft_regions.label: Tests have limits
draft_regions.notes: Detached caveat.

stories.source_fact_1: OpenAI reports scoped cybersecurity research and separate testing for out-of-scope behavior.
stories.source_fact_2: Findings can be validated and used to develop fixes.
stories.exclusion: No guaranteed protection or automatic patch approval.

stories.layout: opposed dense architecture cutaway and benchmark replay bench

draft_regions.label: Dense model
draft_regions.notes: A cutaway shows one uninterrupted stack of dense layers.

draft_regions.label: Open weights
draft_regions.notes: A separate set of layered weights is available for inspection.

draft_regions.label: Replay the test
draft_regions.notes: An independent fixture shows matching benchmark setup, task inputs, run traces and observed outputs.

draft_regions.label: Vendor results
draft_regions.notes: Detached caveat.

stories.source_fact_1: The release describes a modernized dense Transformer rather than a mixture-of-experts model.
stories.source_fact_2: Open weights are available and the publisher reports a coding benchmark.
stories.exclusion: No independently verified score, memory guarantee or equal hardware.

stories.layout: horizontal film strip with revision returning through a lower loop

draft_regions.label: Reference inputs
draft_regions.notes: Abstract material, motion and sound samples feed the film mechanism.

draft_regions.label: Generate clip
draft_regions.notes: A strip of successive frames repeats a distinctive geometric object.

draft_regions.label: Edit the clip
draft_regions.notes: A lower loop carries follow-up adjustments into the existing clip, using one separate return port.

draft_regions.label: Review consistency
draft_regions.notes: An inspection bay compares the output against the original reference; outcomes may vary.

stories.source_fact_1: The model combines visual and other references to guide generation.
stories.source_fact_2: Follow-up turns can refine the same clip.
stories.exclusion: No guaranteed consistency or price-related quality claims.

stories.layout: forked scientific workbench with separated digital and physical arms

draft_regions.label: Research tasks
draft_regions.notes: Several abstract work specimens split into digital and physical branches.

draft_regions.label: Digital work
draft_regions.notes: Digital coding, analysis and information tasks cluster at a computational bench.

draft_regions.label: Physical work
draft_regions.notes: An isolated physical instrument bench remains a practical bottleneck.

draft_regions.label: Scenarios vary
draft_regions.notes: Detached caveat.

stories.source_fact_1: The report studies Claude use across scientific tasks and fields.
stories.source_fact_2: Physical research tasks may remain difficult to automate, and modeled scenarios depend on assumptions.
stories.exclusion: No prediction of researcher replacement or measured causal speedup.

stories.layout: nested trust boundary around a site with two separated identity lanes

draft_regions.label: User authority
draft_regions.notes: Represent delegated user authority as a neutral key-shaped token.

draft_regions.label: Hosted agent
draft_regions.notes: A separate agent identity carries a disclosed request and accountability record.

draft_regions.label: Site policy
draft_regions.notes: A site boundary has distinct inspection, policy decision and permitted-resource ports; a blocked path ends at the boundary.

draft_regions.label: Proposed standard
draft_regions.notes: Detached proposal caveat.

stories.source_fact_1: Hosted agents act as intermediaries and need to disclose their role to sites.
stories.source_fact_2: The proposal calls for agent identity, reputation and accountability with site-defined access.
stories.exclusion: No universal identity proof, automatic permission or deployed standard.

stories.layout: triangulated evidence table with raw-response comparison rail

draft_regions.label: Decision question
draft_regions.notes: One decision question defines what evidence is relevant.

draft_regions.label: Run analysis
draft_regions.notes: Generated code computes summaries from abstract response groups.

draft_regions.label: Check responses
draft_regions.notes: A lower rail independently compares sample counts against original responses.

draft_regions.label: Choose an action
draft_regions.notes: An action station records one choice and a separate exception note.

stories.source_fact_1: Google describes generated Python calculations based on actual form responses.
